lxc_1d674d29be406b00.text: Mob Psycho 100 is a manga and anime story about a quiet boy with unusual powers.

lxc_1eaddb9f3a607fbc.text: Mob Psycho 100 first appeared as a manga, or a Japanese comic series.

lxc_0aff2311dc9f7aa1.text: ONE, a Japanese artist, wrote and drew it.

lxc_378f4f724e05eba3.text: The series began in 2012 and ended in 2017.

lxc_f655f86e8e9ed848.text: Later, Mob Psycho 100 became an anime, or an animated series.

lxc_ea12d15981c0e407.text: People could read the story on a page or watch it move on a screen.

lxc_315804133761f41a.text: The main person is Shigeo Kageyama.

lxc_261e436f66766683.text: He is a quiet boy, but he has psychic powers.

lxc_d7f2a39c86f84a09.text: Psychic powers are unusual powers of the mind.

lxc_a6bfd9f9d64c41d2.text: Mob does not mainly want to be special.

lxc_12d88487258469cf.text: This difference is important: his powers are very big, but his wish is very ordinary.

lxc_152a6f7d8376b076.text: We can understand the story with three ideas: person, wish, and problem.

lxc_b037b4a9249c8dd8.text: His wish is a normal life.

lxc_9d502f5b9777e802.text: The problem is that his psychic powers make his life unusual.

lxc_b834fecebc4a29ab.text: Reigen is part of Mob's work.

lxc_88452b42f5ae52f4.text: This pattern helps us understand the basic story without knowing every event.

lxc_cd838c9a01ce3c82.text: Bones, a Japanese animation studio, later made the anime.

lxc_04a7004cb1e1df0c.text: A season is one group of TV episodes.

lxc_a1e774f820495116.text: These dates show the order clearly: ONE's comic story came first, and the animated version came later.

lxc_0c4e7c3cecae6b5d.text: The story moved from drawn pages to moving pictures and sound.

lxc_f614077cf972d469.text: Now put the main facts together.

lxc_46436867afc7711d.text: ONE created the page version and wrote and drew Mob's story.

lxc_0efea52af8a92e91.text: Bones made the screen version later.

lxc_2ed47475b8b9773e.text: In both forms, Shigeo “Mob” Kageyama is the quiet boy at the center.

lxc_b5886ead553f11f5.text: He has psychic powers, works with Reigen Arataka, and wants a normal life.

lxc_8c8ac59694853131.text: Great power and an ordinary wish are the easiest way to explain the story.
